methods.name: applyActionCode
methods.comment: Applies a verification code sent to the user by email.

methods.name: confirmPasswordReset
methods.comment: Completes the password reset process.

methods.name: confirmVerificationCode
methods.comment: Finishes the phone number verification process.

methods.name: createUserWithEmailAndPassword
methods.comment:
Creates a new user account with email and password.
If the new account was created, the user is signed in automatically.

methods.name: deleteUser
methods.comment: Deletes and signs out the user.

methods.name: fetchSignInMethodsForEmail
methods.comment: Fetches the sign-in methods for an email address.

methods.name: getCurrentUser
methods.comment: Fetches the currently signed-in user.

methods.name: getPendingAuthResult
methods.comment:
Returns the `SignInResult` if your app launched a web sign-in flow and the OS cleans up the app while in the background.

Only available for Android.

methods.name: getIdToken
methods.comment: Fetches the Firebase Auth ID Token for the currently signed-in user.

methods.name: getIdTokenResult
methods.comment: Returns a deserialized JSON Web Token (JWT) used to identify the user to a Firebase service.

methods.name: getRedirectResult
methods.comment:
Returns the `SignInResult` from the redirect-based sign-in flow.

If sign-in was unsuccessful, fails with an error.
If no redirect operation was called, returns a `SignInResult` with a null user.

Only available for Web.

methods.name: getTenantId
methods.comment: Get the tenant id.

methods.name: isSignInWithEmailLink
methods.comment: Checks if an incoming link is a sign-in with email link suitable for `signInWithEmailLink`.

methods.name: linkWithApple
methods.comment:
Links the user account with Apple authentication provider.

The user must be logged in on the native layer.
The `skipNativeAuth` configuration option has no effect here.

methods.name: linkWithEmailAndPassword
methods.comment:
Links the user account with Email authentication provider.

The user must be logged in on the native layer.
The `skipNativeAuth` configuration option has no effect here.

methods.name: linkWithEmailLink
methods.comment:
Links the user account with Email authentication provider.

The user must be logged in on the native layer.
The `skipNativeAuth` configuration option has no effect here.

methods.comment:

The user must be logged in on the native layer.
The `skipNativeAuth` configuration option has no effect here.

methods.name: linkWithGameCenter
methods.comment:

The user must be logged in on the native layer.
The `skipNativeAuth` configuration option has no effect here.

methods.name: linkWithMicrosoft

The `skipNativeAuth` configuration option has no effect here.

methods.name: linkWithOpenIdConnect
methods.comment: Links the user account with an OpenID Connect provider.

methods.name: linkWithPhoneNumber
methods.comment:
Links the user account with Phone Number authentication provider.

The user must be logged in on the native layer.
The `skipNativeAuth` configuration option has no effect here.

Use the `phoneVerificationCompleted` listener to be notified when the verification is completed.
Use the `phoneVerificationFailed` listener to be notified when the verification is failed.
Use the `phoneCodeSent` listener to get the verification id.

methods.name: reload
methods.comment: Reloads user account data, if signed in.

methods.name: revokeAccessToken
methods.comment: Revokes the given access token. Currently only supports Apple OAuth access tokens.

methods.name: sendEmailVerification
methods.comment: Sends a verification email to the currently signed in user.

methods.name: sendPasswordResetEmail
methods.comment: Sends a password reset email.

methods.name: sendSignInLinkToEmail
methods.comment:
Sends a sign-in email link to the user with the specified email.

To complete sign in with the email link, call `signInWithEmailLink` with the email address and the email link supplied in the email sent to the user.

methods.name: setLanguageCode
methods.comment: Sets the user-facing language code for auth operations.

methods.name: setPersistence
methods.comment:
Sets the type of persistence for the currently saved auth session.

Only available for Web.

methods.name: setTenantId
methods.comment: Sets the tenant id.

methods.name: signInAnonymously
methods.comment: Signs in as an anonymous user.

methods.name: signInWithApple
methods.comment: Starts the Apple sign-in flow.

methods.name: signInWithCustomToken
methods.comment:
Starts the Custom Token sign-in flow.

This method cannot be used in combination with `skipNativeAuth` on Android and iOS.
In this case you have to use the `signInWithCustomToken` interface of the Firebase JS SDK directly.

methods.name: signInWithEmailAndPassword
methods.comment: Starts the sign-in flow using an email and password.

methods.name: signInWithEmailLink
methods.comment: Signs in using an email and sign-in email link.

methods.name: signInWithFacebook
methods.comment: Starts the Facebook sign-in flow.

methods.name: signInWithGameCenter
methods.comment:
Starts the Game Center sign-in flow.

Only available for iOS.

methods.name: signInWithGithub
methods.comment: Starts the GitHub sign-in flow.

methods.name: signInWithGoogle
methods.comment: Starts the Google sign-in flow.

methods.name: signInWithMicrosoft
methods.comment: Starts the Microsoft sign-in flow.

methods.name: signInWithOpenIdConnect
methods.comment: Starts the OpenID Connect sign-in flow.

methods.name: signInWithPhoneNumber
methods.comment:
Starts the sign-in flow using a phone number.

Use the `phoneVerificationCompleted` listener to be notified when the verification is completed.
Use the `phoneVerificationFailed` listener to be notified when the verification is failed.
Use the `phoneCodeSent` listener to get the verification id.

methods.name: signOut
methods.comment: Starts the sign-out flow.

methods.name: unlink
methods.comment: Unlinks a provider from a user account.

methods.name: updateEmail
methods.comment: Updates the email address of the currently signed in user.

methods.name: updatePassword
methods.comment: Updates the password of the currently signed in user.

methods.name: updateProfile
methods.comment: Updates a user's profile data.

methods.name: useAppLanguage
methods.comment: Sets the user-facing language code to be the default app language.

methods.name: useEmulator
methods.comment: Instrument your app to talk to the Authentication emulator.

methods.name: verifyBeforeUpdateEmail
methods.comment: Verifies the new email address before updating the email address of the currently signed in user.

methods.name: checkAppTrackingTransparencyPermission
methods.comment:
Checks the current status of app tracking transparency.

Only available on iOS.

methods.name: requestAppTrackingTransparencyPermission
methods.comment:
Opens the system dialog to authorize app tracking transparency.

**Attention:** The user may have disabled the tracking request in the device settings, see [Apple's documentation](https://support.apple.com/guide/iphone/iph4f4cbd242/ios).

Only available on iOS.

methods.name: removeAllListeners
methods.comment: Remove all listeners for this plugin.
